jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in Italy. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. As our first marketing hire in Italy, your work will shape how Italian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Italian priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. - Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. - Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Italian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. - Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. - Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. REQUIREMENTS - 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle. - Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI. - Deep knowledge of the Italian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network. - Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. - Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact. - Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

Global Atlantic is a Top 3 preneed life insurance provider, distributing primarily through approximately 2,400 funeral homes, third-party organizations, and national accounts across the U.S. The Preneed Business Development & Strategic Accounts team is responsible for growing profitable production through our largest and most strategically important distribution partners — including national firms, third-party marketing organizations, and select independent accounts — while continuing to prospect and onboard new relationships in line with the division's growth plan.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Principal, Business Development is a senior individual-contributor role responsible for driving profitable growth across an assigned book of strategic preneed distribution partners and for opening new national and multi-location accounts. Reporting to preneed sales leadership, the Principal owns the end-to-end account strategy — from prospecting and pitching, through contracting and onboarding, to ongoing production management, joint business planning, and executive relationship stewardship. The role partners closely with Regional Sales team, marketing, product, operations, legal, and compliance to translate distributor needs into commercial outcomes and to ensure Global Atlantic remains the carrier of choice in the preneed market.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts (national firms, third-party organizations, and select independent partners); develop and execute account-level business plans that meet or exceed annual preneed sales, retention, and profitability targets.
• Prospect, qualify, and close new strategic account relationships, leading contracting, onboarding, and go-live in coordination with sales leadership, legal, compliance, and operations.
• Serve as the senior day-to-day relationship owner for principals, corporate leaders, and top-producing agents at assigned firms; conduct regular business reviews, joint planning sessions, and on-site visits.
• Partner with the Regional Sales, Account Management and Strategic Accounts team to translate pipeline activity into closed production, ensuring accounts receive best-in-class sales support and product positioning.
• Represent the voice of the distributor internally — surfacing product, illustration, technology, and service enhancements to product, marketing, and operations, and shaping the roadmap for strategic accounts.
• Lead executive-level presentations, RFP responses, and industry-conference engagement (e.g., ICCFA, NFDA, state association meetings) to build Global Atlantic's brand and pipeline in the preneed community.
• Maintain rigorous CRM discipline in Salesforce — logging activity, forecasting production, and providing accurate weekly and monthly pipeline reporting to preneed leadership.
• Coach and informally mentor Senior Analysts, Sales Consultants, and other members of the strategic accounts team; model KKR / Global Atlantic values in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; 8+ years of progressive sales, business development, or key/strategic account management experience, with meaningful time in life insurance, annuities, or preneed distribution.
• Demonstrated track record of carrying and exceeding a multi-million-dollar production or premium quota through third-party distribution (funeral homes, IMOs, TPMs, or national accounts strongly preferred).
• Proven ability to open, contract, and scale complex, multi-stakeholder distribution relationships from prospect to top-producing account.
• Strong command of preneed and/or life insurance product mechanics, illustrations, and regulatory considerations across multiple states; ability to explain features, benefits, and competitive positioning to sophisticated audiences.
• Excellent executive presence with credibility to advise principals and C-suite counterparts at large funeral service operators and marketing organizations.
• Skilled in Salesforce and modern sales technologies; disciplined about pipeline hygiene, activity metrics, and data-driven account planning.
• Life insurance licensing (or willingness to obtain within a defined onboarding period) as required by role and jurisdictions.
• Willingness and ability to travel 8–12 nights per month across the U.S.; this is a remote role working from a home office.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

• Strategic Account Ownership – thinks like a general manager of the account, balancing near-term production with multi-year relationship equity.
• Consultative Selling & Executive Presence – earns trust with sophisticated distributors and closes complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
• Preneed / Life Insurance Acumen – deep working knowledge of preneed products, distribution economics, and the funeral services ecosystem.
• Pipeline & Forecasting Discipline – rigorous CRM, activity, and forecasting habits; predictable delivery against plan.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration – partners effectively with Sales Desk, product, marketing, operations, legal, and compliance to remove friction for distributors.
• Results Orientation & Ownership – takes personal accountability for account outcomes; resilient in a quota-carrying environment.
• Communication & Influence – clear, polished written and verbal communication across agents, principals, and internal executives.
• Integrity & Regulatory Awareness – operates with a high compliance bar in a regulated, multi-state insurance environment.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Software Engineer, Billing to evolve the systems that power how Cursor charges and reconciles revenue across millions of developers and enterprise teams.

You will work across the billing stack — usage metering pipelines, subscription and entitlement systems, payment integrations, and the ledger layer — to make billing accurate, scalable, and transparent. This is a deeply technical IC role. It is not a finance ops role, and it is not a backend generalist role wearing a billing hat.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Implement usage and billing systems changes end-to-end, from updates in the UI and raw usage events at the edge to invoiced amounts in Stripe, including the metering pipeline, aggregation logic, entitlement enforcement, and ledger.

- Evolve our ledger system that serves as the source of truth for customer balances, credits, overages, and adjustments — with the correctness guarantees that financial systems require.

- Integrate deeply with Stripe including subscriptions, usage records, invoices, webhooks, and edge cases like mid-cycle plan changes, prorations, and failed payment recovery.

- Build billing APIs and internal tooling that product, finance, and customer success teams depend on to query customer state, issue credits, and investigate billing anomalies.

- Improve observability across the billing pipeline — metering lag, reconciliation discrepancies, invoice accuracy — so the team can quickly detect and debug billing regressions.

- Partner with product, infrastructure, and finance teams to ship new pricing models with confidence and minimal operational risk.

- You will own usage & limits across the product family, payments (stripe + daily jobs), grants & promotions, ledger, and internal data insights. You will be a technical authority on billing correctness and scale.

- You will not own tax compliance, or general finance infrastructure unless it intersects directly with the billing system.

- You will not be a backend generalist who contributes to billing occasionally. This is the core of your scope.

- Revenue accuracy is part of the job, but the goal is to build systems with enough correctness and observability that billing is boring — not to manually reconcile every edge case.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You’ve shipped a usage-based billing system in production and have opinions on metering architecture, idempotency, and exactly-once semantics.

- You’ve integrated deeply with Stripe, understand its data model, and have dealt with erroring webhooks.

- You’ve built or maintained a financial ledger and understand why it’s required.

- You care about correctness and making sure customer’s don’t have to manually review their invoices.

- You can hold the tension between "move fast" and "do not lose revenue or trust."

- You feel comfortable shipping features end-to-end - scaling up infrastructure to tweaking a UI component.

The Natural Cheese R&D Product Development Manager serves as a technical thought leader driving business goals and R&D foundational vision across Retail and B2B natural cheese platforms. Team Leadership and Organizational Effectiveness

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of scientists, fostering a culture of curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

• Serve as a technical mentor, strengthening capability in technical learning, experimental design, critical thinking, risk assessment, and data-driven decision making.

• Provide clear direction, candid feedback, and development support while empowering scientists to own execution and outcomes.

• Promote focus, prioritization, timely decision making, and constructive technical debate.

Natural Cheese Technical Leadership

• Provide deep expertise across the complete cheesemaking lifecycle, from milk standardization and culture/enzyme systems to aging and functionality.

• Deepen organizational knowledge of the chemical, physical, and microbial drivers of core products.

• Guide formulation and process refinements to improve product consistency, functionality, and flavor.

Operational Partnership & Technical Enablement

• Build trust-based, collaborative relationships across the manufacturing network—partnering closely with plant managers, quality, engineering, process technology, and operations teams.

• Clarify ownership, accountability, and partnership models across functions.

• Champion the use of manufacturing data, advanced analytics, and AI tools to accelerate root-cause analysis, drive yield and cost optimizations, and transition the team from reactive troubleshooting to proactive process control.

• Support implementation of new technologies and manufacturing capabilities.

Business and Portfolio Leadership

• Drive effective use of resources across technical functions.

• Align technical priorities with business objectives.

• Translate complex dairy science and manufacturing realities into clear business trade-offs and actionable recommendations.

Required Experience & Capabilities

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Dairy Science, Food Science, Chemical/Biological Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Technical Experience: 8+ years of progressive technical experience in dairy, with an emphasis on natural cheese.

• People Leadership: Minimum 3+ years of direct people management experience with a proven track record of coaching, developing talent, and building high-trust team cultures.

• Plant Fluency: Extensive experience collaborating with commercial manufacturing plants, scale-up environments, and plant quality teams.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Proven track record of building alignment across diverse stakeholders, navigating technical and operational trade-offs, and driving results through collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced Degree: Master’s or Ph.D. in Dairy Science, Food Science, or Fermentation/Bioprocess Engineering.

• Digital & Analytical Acumen: Experience applying statistical process control (SPC), design of experiments (DOE), advanced data analytics, or AI-assisted modeling.

• Continuous Improvement: Formal training in Lean, Six Sigma, or structured Root Cause Analysis methodologies.
